headline: Microsoft describes Project Perception as a control system for internal AI agents
summary: Microsoft’s Oct 19 announcement describes applying Project Perception to enterprise agents through identity, permissions, risk assessment and Guardian Agents. Follow-up Microsoft Learn documentation gives a narrower implementation picture: Defender for Endpoint runtime protection is a limited preview with audit/block modes for selected Windows/agent combinations, while Entra Agent ID availability and paid licensing for extended protections are described separately. These are first-party product claims and setup instructions, not evidence of measured efficacy, broad deployment or independent validation.
